issue.title: Fix issue #23720 and issue #23699

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
For issue #23720 we have added an if statement before currenFieldName is set, in order to check if the entry is correct and would not cause an error later on. If it is incorrect, a helpful error message will appear explaining what the problem is.

For issue #23699 we were unable to fully solve the issue but we located the document and commented what we think might be wrong. No changes to the code were made because we cannot be sure to not break the code.

We also experienced many problems running gradle on the lab computers which made it hard to run elasticsearch and test effectively, however we eventually got gradle and elasticsearch working on our personal laptops but still had some issues with testing.

issue.title: Pass over _routing value with more_like_this items to be retrieved

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When retrieving documents to extract terms from as part of a more like this query, the _routing value can be set, yet it gets lost. That leads to not being able to retrieve the documents, hence more_like_this used to return no matches all the time.

Closes #23699

issue.title: More-like-this query routing fix

repository.name: elastic4s
repository.description: 🔍 Elasticsearch Scala Client - Reactive, Non Blocking, Type Safe, HTTP Client

issue.body:
`more_like_this` query does not work for parent-child relationship without explicit routing parameter, and there was no way to specify it. 

I changed `MoreLikeThisItem` a bit , but it should support old API calls.

ElasticSearch team recently fixed a linked bug https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/23699 (routing parameter in `more_like_this` was ignored), so Elastic version had to be updated to 5.4.1
